Checked ulong add and sub helpers with overflow error handling.

# Purpose
This header file defines small utility functions for checked `ulong` arithmetic in the Flamenco runtime program code. The functions [`fd_ulong_checked_add`](<#fd_ulong_checked_add>) and [`fd_ulong_checked_sub`](<#fd_fn_unusedfd_ulong_checked_sub>) use compiler overflow builtins to detect wraparound and return executor status codes instead of raw arithmetic results. The helper functions [`fd_ulong_checked_add_expect`](<#fd_ulong_checked_add_expect>) and [`fd_ulong_checked_sub_expect`](<#fd_ulong_checked_sub_expect>) call the checked operations and log an error with `FD_LOG_ERR` if overflow or underflow occurs. The file also includes the needed runtime and executor error headers and wraps the declarations in include guards and `FD_PROTOTYPES_BEGIN` / `FD_PROTOTYPES_END`.
